SELECT reserve1 AS lon, reserve2 AS lat, park_name AS parkName, COUNT(*) AS spaceCount FROM parking_space WHERE deleted = FALSE
AND park_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{parkName}, '%')
GROUP BY park_name, reserve1, reserve2 ORDER BY spaceCount DESC

SELECT reserve1 AS lon, reserve2 AS lat, space_code AS spaceCode FROM parking_space WHERE deleted = FALSE
AND park_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{parkName}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalSpace, SUM(CASE WHEN space_status = '空闲' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS freeSpace, SUM(CASE WHEN space_status = '占用' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occupySpace, SUM(CASE WHEN space_status = '预约中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reserveSpace FROM parking_space WHERE deleted = FALSE
AND park_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{parkName}, '%')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:00') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM parking_space WHERE deleted = FALSE
AND park_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{parkName}, '%')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:00') ORDER BY name

SELECT space_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM parking_space WHERE deleted = FALSE
AND park_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{parkName}, '%')
GROUP BY space_type ORDER BY value DESC
